title: A sprint of more than 20 open items gets an estimate over all of them, its review story included
goal: mon_eta.estimate counts every open item of an active sprint, its review story included, or the basis says how many open items it left out; the sprint panel still keeps OPEN_KEPT open items for its text

run: import inspect,sys;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import mon_sprint as m;s=inspect.getsource(m.sprint_row);sys.exit(1 if "for i in left[:OPEN_KEPT]]" in s and "open_all" not in s and "left_out" not in s else 0)
